design.objective: Estimate Var[G(s,xi)|s] for identical Macro state and frozen policy, varying only future task draws.

cost_protection.reduction_reason: 96 branches projected about 2.3 hours; 48 about 79 minutes; selected 6x6=36 at the lower bound, projected about 54 minutes.

frozen_policy.trace_replay_checks: Pre-witness observations and Cache action/duration reproduced exactly against stored same-policy trace.

sampling.sampler: scenario.task_scenario.generate_tasks with formal TaskConfig from system_config.toml
sampling.rho_star_source: existing popularity.csv per-slot rho_star, fixed across branches
sampling.seed_streams: independent SeedSequence child generators for arrival, request, workload

statistics.frame_reward_definition: gamma-discounted reward in first Macro frame from witness origin; across branches within witness.

decision.NEXT_DECISION: 先增加 witness/continuation 数量验证，不修改正式算法。

thresholds.high: (noise fraction >= 0.30 or median std/global >= 0.30) and at least half witnesses ratio >= 0.15
thresholds.otherwise: MATERIAL; add witnesses before algorithm changes

counts.scope_note: MATCHING_CALLS and KKT_CALLS include only the completed measured diagnostic and its final prefix replay; they exclude the earlier interrupted preflight whose calls were not recorded.

PRE_EXISTING_CONFIG_CHANGE.difference: macro_critic_replay_history_episodes=0 in worktree vs 4 in checkpoint.
PRE_EXISTING_CONFIG_CHANGE.validation: Restoring only that value in memory exactly reproduced checkpoint raw and semantic config hashes; file untouched.

TEMP_FILES_CLEANED: YES: temporary driver, progress file, __pycache__ directories and *.pyc files removed; no task, checkpoint or tensor artifacts were written.

ABORTED_PREFLIGHT_ATTEMPT.status: interrupted before any continuation branch completed
ABORTED_PREFLIGHT_ATTEMPT.reason: The initial slow-loader attempt had no per-slot call instrumentation; its partial prefix calls cannot be reconstructed.
